smalltalk_hk.headline: Hong Kong October Temperatures Break 140-Year Record
smalltalk_hk.body: The Hong Kong Observatory recorded an average monthly temperature of 27.6°C, making last month the warmest October since records began in 1884. Officials attributed the unusual heat to a strong El Niño event combined with weak northeasterly monsoons.

smalltalk_hk.headline: Wine & Dine Festival Wraps Up with Boosted Sales
